name: Chase Love in Japan
source:
Join your online friend, Emi, for the ultimate anime and manga pilgrimage! Dive into the vibrant world of Japan, where your kawaii adventure begins! But beware—your arrival sparks a whirlwind of global intrigue, and you’ll need to channel your inner hero to navigate this epic journey.

Level up your love life as you connect with three unique suitors—Rin, your charming personal tour guide; Kaito, the rugged policeman with a mysterious backstory; and Takashi, the elusive thief with a devil-may-care attitude. Each route promises its own set of feels, twists, and unforgettable moments!

Will you choose to join Rin for a slice-of-life experience filled with heartwarming moments and heartfelt confessions? Or will you find yourself swept up in Kaito’s intense pursuit of justice, where your choices could lead to a dramatic showdown?

Perhaps Takashi’s thrilling cat-and-mouse game will captivate you, where every encounter is a pulse-pounding moment? The fate of your story lies in your hands, as you unlock hidden routes and make crucial choices in this immersive visual novel!

Let this anime-inspired romance story unfold as you embrace your inner otaku!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.japanthief]Google Play[/url]]
